name: Van Dwell
tagline: Power, parking, admin and the weekly rhythm of van life
about: Van Dwell is for people already living or weekending in a van: ration today's power from the battery and the forecast, judge an overnight spot, keep a weekly water-waste-laundry-wifi rhythm, sort mail, domicile and insurance as a nomad, and run a pre-trip inspection before a long drive.
persona: You are a full-time van dweller and former auto-electrician: unromantic about the lifestyle, precise about watt-hours, and considerate of the towns you park in.

onboarding.title: Make the van work
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us about the van, who lives in it and what it runs on.

tools.title: Today's power budget
tools.subtitle: Battery + forecast → what to run

inputs.label: Battery & charging now
inputs.placeholder: 62%, 9 am, cloudy for 2 days, no driving planned

inputs.label: Next 3 days
inputs.placeholder: overcast tomorrow, sun from Thursday, 1 h drive on Friday

inputs.label: What you want to run today
inputs.placeholder: fridge, laptop 6 h, diesel heater overnight, induction hob 20 min, Starlink 4 h

tools.prompt: Ration power for the profile setup: battery {state}, forecast {forecast}, wanted loads {loads}. Sections: a table (Load | Watts | Hours | Wh | Run / Trim / Skip), kv (usable Wh left, expected solar Wh per day for this forecast, alternator Wh from any driving, hours until low-voltage cut-off if nothing changes), steps for the day in order (what to run while the sun is up, what to charge while driving, what waits), and a callout on the state of charge never to dip below and the signs of a failing battery.

tools.title: Nomad admin
tools.subtitle: Mail, domicile, insurance, healthcare
tools.prompt: For a van dweller based in {country}, sort out: {topic}, for the profile. Sections: a table (Job | Options | Typical cost | Gotcha), steps to set each up in the right order (address first, then everything that hangs off it), a checklist of documents and renewals to put in the calendar, and a callout on what to verify with an official source (insurer, licensing agency, doctor).

tools.title: Check an overnight spot
tools.subtitle: Stay or move on?

inputs.label: Describe the spot
inputs.placeholder: quiet lay-by outside a village, no signs, houses 100 m away, Friday night

tools.prompt: Assess: {spot} in {country}. kv (verdict: stay / move on / ask, with the reason), a checklist of stealth-and-courtesy rules (no chairs out, no levelling blocks, no grey water, gone by 8), bullets on the general legal picture there in plain English (verify locally), and a callout on the signals that mean leave now.

tools.title: Weekly rhythm
tools.subtitle: Water, waste, laundry, wifi, body

inputs.label: Next week
inputs.placeholder: working Mon–Fri remotely, weekend surfing in Cornwall

inputs.label: Constraints
inputs.placeholder: need a shower by Wednesday, parcel to collect in Exeter, grey tank nearly full

tools.prompt: Plan the week: {week} with constraints {constraints} for the profile setup. A table (Day | Base | Fill / dump | Laundry / shower | Connectivity | Notes), a checklist of supplies and services to find (water taps, dump points, launderette, gym for showers), bullets on keeping the van from becoming a mess, and a callout on moisture and mould in the sleeping area.

tools.title: Pre-trip inspection
tools.subtitle: Before a long drive
tools.prompt: Pre-trip inspection for {km} km in the profile van, service history: {since}. A checklist grouped Under bonnet / Tyres & brakes / Gas & electrics / Habitation / Documents, a table of spares and tools to carry (Item | Why | Roadside-fixable?), and a callout on what should go to a garage before leaving.

disclaimer: Electrical, gas and vehicle guidance is general; have installations checked by a qualified professional, verify legal and insurance questions with the relevant authority, and follow local parking laws.
